If someone wants less, let’s agree on any transfer before fishing so our total stays at or below 50 tons. John, does that work for you?

Welcome, Luke. Count me in for 10 tons. My family taught me to leave enough in the lake for the next month, and this plan gives all five of us a steady income. Let’s make any share transfers explicit here before fishing—no assuming an unused share is up for grabs. John, Emma, are you both on board?

I’m on board for 10 tons, with any share transfers agreed here beforehand. This lake supports more than our businesses—it supports our village. Let’s check the stock and everyone’s catch together each month, and adjust our limit if the lake ever starts below 100 tons. John, can you commit to the same plan?
